.name: Batch translate achievements
.note: Save achievement translations supplied by the chat model. Read achievement sources and revisions first.
.parameters.changes: Send each AppID and its translations. Copy id, title, description and revision from the read tool, then add translatedTitle and translatedDescription.
.description: Save achievement translations supplied by the chat model. Read achievement sources and revisions first.
.error.badTranslation: Provide the target language, source achievement text, revisions and translations for each AppID.
.parameters.id: Achievement id from the read result.
.parameters.title: Original achievement title.
.parameters.description: Original achievement description. May be an empty string.
.parameters.revision: The revision from the read result for this achievement.
.parameters.translatedDescription: Translated achievement description. May be an empty string.
